close_reason: Inlined the one remaining rfc5280.rs format!() (serialNumber overflow detail) with let-bound 'cap = self.max_octets'. The other .43-flagged site (signatureAlgorithm mismatch) was already inlined in PKIX-7f92.3, and the .to_string()-on-literal smell was already removed in PKIX-7f92.5/.39. 307 tests pass; clippy clean.
description:
pkix-lint/src/rfc5280.rs has two clippy::uninlined_format_args holdouts and one clippy::str_to_string smell:

* Lines 182-185: `format!("certificate serialNumber is {} octets, exceeds cap of {} octets", len, self.max_octets)` — should inline to `{len}` and `{cap}` with a local bind.
* Lines 596-600: `format!("outer signatureAlgorithm ({}) does not match … ({}); RFC 5280 §4.1.1.2 requires both to be identical", outer.oid, inner.oid)` — same.
* Line 161: `reason: "max-octets must be at least 1".to_string()` — the literal is a `&'static str`, so `.to_owned()` is the idiomatic conversion (matches the surrounding ParameterError shape which takes `String` via `.to_owned()` already on line 155).

No behavior change; mechanical fix via clippy --fix.
title: uninlined format args + redundant .to_string in pkix-lint/src/rfc5280.rs
